summary: SeedWise is a decision tool for smallholder farmers anywhere, built for "Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data". For one field it recommends which crop rotation to grow across the year, when to sow and how to plant it, scoring each rotation against the farmer's own priorities (water, income, risk, labour), and adds a daily flood and drought brief. It runs on global NASA data (HLS, POWER, GPM IMERG, SMAP, GRACE-FO, NASADEM, Landsat), so any field on Earth can be added; we proved it end to end with real data on three pilot fields in Rangpur, Bangladesh. Two models we fine-tuned power it: NASA–IBM Prithvi-EO-2.0 for flood water (89.7 mIoU on Sen1Floods11, flood events on 6 continents) and a Chronos-Bolt forecaster on 45 years of NASA POWER. Mobile, bilingual, offline once loaded.

The Problem: Farming in a Changing Climate Smallholder farmers feed the world, yet they are the hardest hit by sudden flash floods, droughts, and shifting weather patterns. While NASA satellites collect terabytes of life-saving Earth observation data every day, a farmer in rural Bangladesh cannot read raw satellite bands or netCDF files. They just need to know: "What should I plant next, when should I sow it, and is a flood coming this week?"

What SeedWise Does (In Simple Terms) SeedWise bridges the gap between orbit and one small field. It translates 7 global NASA satellite and climate datasets into a fast, visual, mobile-friendly web app:

  • 1-Click 3D Field Studio: Farmers select their field on the map (or explore our 3 real pilot farms in Gangachara, Mithapukur, and Pirganj in Rangpur, Bangladesh)and see a live 3D terrain and soil-moisture view of their land.
  • Planty Plans (Smart Crop Rotation): Recommends which crops to grow across the year and when to sow them. Farmers use simple sliders to weight what matters most to them: Water Saving, Income, Low Risk, or Low Labor.
  • Live Weather, Flood & Drought Briefs : Combines live local weather forecasts with satellite soil-water and rainfall tracking to give farmers a daily plain-language brief and emergency flash-flood/drought alerts before disaster strikes.
  • AI Plant Clinic: Farmers can upload or snap a photo of a sick leaf to get instant pest/disease diagnostics and recovery steps.
  • Connected Season Calendar: The farmer's chosen plan becomes a live calendar of sowing, growing and harvest days with weekly tasks, linked to the field's daily risk analytics.
  • Weather: A 7-day field forecast with spray, irrigation and heat tips, plus the last 10 days observed by NASA POWER.

How It Works: Our NASA Data & Fine-Tuned AI Engine We didn't just call a generic wrapper—we built an end-to-end geospatial and AI pipeline:

  1. Flood & Surface Water Detection: We fine-tuned the NASA-IBM Prithvi-EO-2.0 (300M) geospatial foundation model on Sen1Floods11, achieving 89.7 mIoU to accurately map flood risks at the field level.
  2. Weather & Soil Time-Series Forecasting: We integrated Chronos-Bolt with 5-year historical archives (2021–2025) of NASA GPM IMERG rainfall and NASA POWER agroclimatology data to forecast rainfall anomalies, temperature shifts, and dry spells.
  3. 3D Field & Boundary Segmentation: Powered by Meta SAM 3.1 for field parcel delineation, NASADEM for 3D elevation/low-ground flood pooling analysis, and SMAP + GRACE-FO for surface and root-zone groundwater tracking.

Real-World Impact & Benefits

  • Built for Farmers, Not Data Scientists: A clean, light-mode visual UI with 3D previews and simple scores (0–100) so any farmer or agricultural extension worker can make decisions in seconds.
  • Proven on Real Farms, Scalable Globally: Tested end-to-end with real 2021–2025 satellite and meteorological archives across three sub-districts in Rangpur, Bangladesh (Gangachara, Mithapukur, Pirganj), while architected to support any GPS coordinate on Earth.
  • Water & Income Protection: Helps farmers avoid planting flood-sensitive crops in low-lying zones right before monsoon peaks, cutting crop loss and water waste.

Tools, Languages & Software Used

  • Frontend & 3D Studio: Next.js, React, Three.js / WebGL (3D Field Planner), CSS3, HTML5.
  • AI & Machine Learning: NASA-IBM Prithvi-EO-2.0-300M-TL, Chronos-Bolt (Time-Series Forecasting), Meta SAM 3.1, Meta Muse, Claude / HyperFrames.
  • Geospatial & Data Processing: Python, Sentinel-2 / HLS Tile Processing, JSON Time-Series Pipelines.
  • Deployment: Live cloud hosting (seedwise.onefusionlab.systems).

5. Use of Super Intelligence (SI)

SI INSIDE THE APP

  • NASA-IBM Prithvi-EO-2.0: we fine-tuned it ourselves on Sen1Floods11 to map flood water on NASA HLS images of each field.
  • Amazon Chronos-Bolt: we fine-tuned it ourselves on NASA POWER data to forecast rain, temperature and soil wetness 1-3 months ahead.
  • Meta SAM 3.1: finds the leaf in a farmer's photo in the crop clinic.
  • Meta Muse models: power Planty, the chat helper, crop advice and clinic answers, using only our cited sources.
  • All model results are labelled as estimates in the app.

SI USED TO BUILD THE PROJECT

  • Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity, Mistral Vibe: helped write, test and debug code. The team planned, reviewed and approved all work.
  • Claude: helped with research, data checks, writing, editing and Bangla translation.
  • Claude: wrote the code for the motion graphics in the demo video (marked on screen).
  • Google Gemini for writting, idea genaration and image creation

NOT SI

  • The voiceover is a real human voice.
  • All data shown is real data from NASA and the other listed sources.
  • The idea, story, field choices and model training were done by Team Kothinn.
